title: Update HOT PICK floating button + bottom-of-page Motorola HOT PICK section with SEO content, real product image, and analytics tracking

requirements.text: Update the existing floating HOT PICK button so it remains a fixed floating action button (not sticky to any section), displays the label "🔥 HOT PICK", and on click smoothly scrolls to the dedicated HOT PICK content section that is located at the bottom of the page.

quotes:
Keep it as a floating button (not sticky to any section)
- Label: 🔥 HOT PICK
- On click, scroll smoothly to the HOT PICK content section at the bottom of the page
Keep this HOT PICK section always at the bottom of the page

acceptanceCriteria: A floating button is visible above page content and does not change layout/position based on sections (fixed positioning).
Button text is exactly "🔥 HOT PICK".
Clicking the button performs smooth scrolling to the HOT PICK section at the bottom of the page.

requirements.text: Add GA4 analytics click tracking for the floating HOT PICK button click with event name "hot_pick_click" (include at least page_url in event parameters) without breaking when analytics is not available.

quotes: Add click tracking for analytics (event: hot_pick_click)

acceptanceCriteria: Each HOT PICK button click triggers a GA4 event named "hot_pick_click" when GA4 is available.
If GA4 is unavailable, clicking the button still scrolls and the app does not error.
Event parameters include page_url = current window.location.href.

requirements.text: Create/update the bottom-of-page HOT PICK content section to use the title text exactly: "🔥 HOT PICK – Latest Motorola Signature Smartphone" and keep this section always rendered as the last section on the page so it stays at the bottom.

quotes:
HOT PICK Content Title
🔥 HOT PICK – Latest Motorola Signature Smartphone

acceptanceCriteria: A HOT PICK section exists at the bottom of the page (last major section rendered in the app).
The section title text is exactly "🔥 HOT PICK – Latest Motorola Signature Smartphone".

requirements.text: Add two enquiry CTAs directly below the HOT PICK section content: a Call button linking to the existing store phone number and a WhatsApp button linking to the existing store WhatsApp number, using the same clean visual styling patterns as existing CTA buttons.

quotes: Add Call and WhatsApp buttons below this section for instant enquiry.

Call uses a tel: link for the existing phone number already used elsewhere in the app.
WhatsApp uses a wa.me (or equivalent) link for the existing WhatsApp number already used elsewhere in the app.

requirements.text: Add a clean, premium Motorola Signature smartphone product image to the HOT PICK section as a static frontend asset, matching the same clean product-section visual style used elsewhere, and meeting all image constraints (white/transparent background, product-only, centered, no lifestyle scene).

quotes:

requirements.text: Ensure the HOT PICK updates are isolated: only the HOT PICK floating button and the bottom HOT PICK section are modified/added, and no other existing sections’ layout or working functionality changes.

quotes:
Layout Rules
- Keep this HOT PICK section always at the bottom of the page

- Do not affect other sections or layout

Do not change any existing working functionality.

acceptanceCriteria: Existing sections (hero, services, tracking initialization, other CTAs, and existing HOT details behavior) continue to function as before.
No unintended spacing/positioning regressions occur in other sections across mobile and desktop breakpoints.
HOT PICK section remains the last section on the page after changes.

constraints: Do not change any existing working functionality outside the HOT PICK floating button and the new/updated bottom-of-page HOT PICK section.
Do not edit files under frontend/src/components/ui or any frontend immutablePaths listed in SYSTEM_CONTEXT.
Backend must remain single-actor; no new backend services or external databases.
nonGoals: Changing or redesigning other product/service sections.
Adding new authentication, admin panels, CMS, or backend-driven content management for HOT PICK.
Implementing third-party analytics providers beyond the existing GA4 integration already present in the project.
